name: Grommash Hold
summary: In Orgrimmar's Valley of Wisdom, Grommash Hold commands the red cliffs as Thrall's seat. Named for Grommash Hellscream's sacrifice, it is the political heart of the new Horde.

sections.title: The Seat of the Warchief
sections.body: Grommash Hold rises from the cliffs of the Valley of Wisdom, where Thrall receives emissaries, petitioners, and warlords. Its thick stone halls stay dim and chilly, a choice meant to keep those who attend his audiences alert and sober. Thrall weighs the defense of Kalimdor with veteran counselors such as Eitrigg, while racial chieftains like Vol'jin visit the hold.

sections.title: The Monument to Freedom
sections.body: Outside the fortress, Mannoroth's shattered armor and horned skull hang from the trunk of an ancient tree. The memorial honors Grom Hellscream, who gave his life to slay the pit lord in Ashenvale. It recalls the orcs' freedom from the demonic blood curse and warns against returning to reckless savagery.

faq.answer: Warchief Thrall holds court in Grommash Hold with Horde leaders and advisors, including the orcish elder Eitrigg, Darkspear leader Vol'jin, and warrior Nazgrel.

faq.q: Why is it named Grommash Hold?
faq.answer: Grommash Hold takes its name from Grommash 'Grom' Hellscream, the legendary chieftain of the Warsong clan. During the Third War, Grom killed the pit lord Mannoroth at the cost of his own life, freeing the orcs from demonic servitude.

faq.q: What are the giant bones displayed outside?
faq.answer: The giant skull and armor belong to Mannoroth, whose blood first enslaved the orcs on Draenor. The remains were brought from Ashenvale and mounted on a tree trunk outside the hold to honor the Horde's freedom.

faq.q: Why do some city signs call it Thrall's Fortress?
faq.answer: Orcish guards and older directional signs still call the structure Thrall's Fortress, after the warchief who holds court inside.

angles.text: At Grommash Hold, the Horde's sovereignty is centered. Treaties are forged here, and campaigns against threats across Kalimdor and the Eastern Kingdoms are directed from its halls.
For orcs, Grommash Hold and Mannoroth's remains outside recall Grom Hellscream's sacrifice, which freed their people from the demonic blood curse.
